title: 第一卷 第20章 魔修上门第一卷 第19章 新徒入峰
slug: 百倍返还我家孽徒全是女帝转世
content_zh:
苏婉清目光落在林枫一身紫金法袍上，眼底闪过一抹惊艳。
“林峰主这身法袍，倒是气韵非凡。”苏婉清由衷赞叹。
两个徒弟也是瞪大了眼睛，第一次见师傅穿其他颜色的衣服，看起来更强了啊！
苏婉清看着赤瑶，笑道：“恭喜你得了这么一个天骄弟子。
我此番前来，是上次黑衣人一事有了新的动静。”
林枫颔首：“苏峰主请说。”
“苏婉清柳眉紧蹙，语气凝重，“昨夜宗门监控阵法有异动，捕捉到一丝微弱魔气，就出现在青云山内。”
“结合寂界玉璋一事推断，对方大概率是十年前漏网的魔道余孽，暗中勾结了本土势力，蛰伏在清溪镇一带。”
林枫眸底寒光一闪。
魔修……灵根被废一仇他还没报，竟然还敢找上门！
二人又简单寒暄两句，苏婉清便离开了小竹峰。
小竹峰再度恢复清静。
林枫看着身前两名徒弟，寒意渐渐收敛。
“雨姝，我今日传你地品功法《水月心经》，若有不懂的再来问我。”
林枫抬手一点，一道灵光飞入柳雨姝脑海，海量功法口诀瞬间烙印在她神魂之中。
柳雨姝欣喜道：“多谢师父。”
林枫又转头看向一旁跃跃欲试的赤瑶：“三日之后，为师亲手为你剑身铭刻火属性铭文，再传你火道功法。”
赤瑶双眸瞬间亮如星火，铿锵应声：“多谢师父！”
接下的日子，小竹峰修炼氛围拉满。
因为修炼效率提升了10%，两人越修越爽。

柳雨姝借助全新功法，修为突破至炼气五层；赤瑶更是天赋爆表，很快从炼气一层冲到炼气四层。
炼器台，林枫负手而立，身前悬浮着那柄天品灵剑。
经过三日的附魔，剑身上闪着层层赤红焰纹，威压暴涨！
林枫抬手将长剑递出，语气慵懒：“收好。”
赤瑶双手接剑，她眼底满是崇敬，语气雀跃：“谢师尊赐宝！”
“叮！弟子赤瑶好感度涨至50。”
“触发20倍暴击！”
“奖励：弟子修炼效率+5%，宿主炼器成功率加10%”
林枫眸底闪过一抹精光，但转瞬即逝。
“起来吧。”
林枫抬手扶起赤瑶，正想叮嘱两句，天际突然传来急促的传音符。
content_en:
Su Wanqing's eyes fell on Lin Feng's purple and gold robe, and a flash of surprise flashed in her eyes.
"Master Lin's robe has an extraordinary charm." Su Wanqing admired sincerely.
The two apprentices also widened their eyes. It was the first time they saw their master wearing clothes of other colors. They looked even stronger!
Su Wanqing looked at Chi Yao and said with a smile: "Congratulations on having such a proud disciple.
I came here this time because there was new news about the man in black last time. "
Lin Feng nodded: "Master Su, please speak."
Su Wanqing frowned and spoke solemnly, "Last night the sect's monitoring array had a strange movement, and a faint trace of demonic energy was captured, which appeared in Qingyun Mountain." "
"Based on the Jijie Yuzhang incident, we can infer that the other party is most likely a remnant of the demonic path who slipped through the net ten years ago, secretly colluded with local forces, and is dormant in the Qingxi Town area. "
Lin Feng's eyes flashed coldly.
The demon cultivator... He hasn't even avenged his spiritual root being destroyed, yet he still dares to come to his door!
The two exchanged brief greetings, and Su Wanqing left Xiaozhu Peak.
Xiaozhu Peak was quiet again.
Lin Feng looked at the two apprentices in front of him, and his chill gradually subsided.
"Yushu, today I will teach you the Dipin Kung Fu "Shui Yue Heart Sutra". If you don't understand anything, come and ask me. "
Lin Feng raised his hand, and a flash of light flew into Liu Yushu's mind, and a large number of martial arts formulas were instantly imprinted on her soul.
Liu Yushu said happily: "Thank you so much, Master. "
Lin Feng turned to look at Chi Yao who was eager to try: "Three days later, my master will personally carve a fire attribute inscription on your sword body, and then teach you the fire technique. "
Chi Yao's eyes instantly lit up like sparks, and she responded sonorously: "Thank you, Master!" "
In the following days, the cultivation atmosphere at Xiaozhu Peak was full.
Because the cultivation efficiency increased by 10%, the two of them became more and more comfortable as they practiced.
With the help of the new technique, Liu Yushu broke through to the fifth level of Qi Refining; Chiyao's talent was beyond the limit, and she quickly rushed from the first level of Qi Refining to the fourth level.
On the weapon refining table, Lin Feng stood with his hands behind his back, with the heavenly grade spiritual sword suspended in front of him.
After three days of enchantment, the sword was flashing with layers of red flame patterns, and its power surged!
Lin Feng raised his hand and handed out the long sword, saying in a lazy tone: "Put it away. "
Chi Yao took the sword with both hands, her eyes were full of reverence, and her tone was cheerful: "Thank you, Master, for the treasure! "
“Ding! Disciple Chi Yao's favorability level increased to 50. "
"Trigger 20x critical hit! "
"Reward: Disciple's cultivation efficiency +5%, host's weapon refining success rate +10%"
A flash of light flashed in Lin Feng's eyes, but it was fleeting.
"Get up. "
Lin Feng raised his hand to help Chi Yao up. Just as he was about to give some instructions, a rapid sound transmission sound suddenly came from the sky.
